description: This file contains database migration scripts for the Notesnook project, defining schema creation, updates, and index management using Kysely ORM.

classes.name: NNMigrationProvider
classes.description: Provides database migration implementations for the Notesnook project, including schema setup and updates.

methods.name: getMigrations
methods.description: Returns a record of migration steps identified by version keys, each with 'up' and 'down' functions.

methods.name: addBaseColumns
methods.description: Adds common base columns to a table schema builder.

methods.name: addTrashColumns
methods.description: Adds trash-related columns to a table schema builder.

methods.name: createFTS5Table
methods.description: Creates a virtual FTS5 table with specified columns and options.

methods.name: runFTSTablesMigrations
methods.description: Drops existing FTS tables and recreates them with specific tokenizer configurations, then rebuilds the search index.
